title: [3.x] Add `Span` and some basic uses from `Geometry`.
body:
Since we added `Span` to 4.x, it's been a goal to also add it to 3.x, as it makes a lot more sense for functions that can be called with e.g. `Vector`, `LocalVector` or `PoolVector` as parameters, and would otherwise require needless conversion, wasting performance.

Here I've mostly straight up copied @Ivorforce implementation from #100293 , with some small changes:

* Instead of fixing size to `uint64_t`, I've used a template parameter `U` (as in `LocalVector`) and defaulted to `uint32_t`. 3.x is designed much more with 32 bit in mind and it likely makes a lot more sense than 64 bit here.
* I've removed `is_zero_constructible` from `Span`, we don't yet have this functionality in 3.x.

In the spirit of adding some use cases rather than purely adding the `Span` functionality, I've converted a couple of functions in `Geometry` to use `Span`. There are many more functions to convert (and I have already started a followup PR for this), but I'm trying to keep this initial PR as simple as possible to make it easy to review.

## Notes
* I haven't converted `StrRange` from `ustring.h`. That can probably be done as a later PR if desired. To be honest the string stuff works in 3.x, and isn't being changed much these days so there isn't a huge push to change it immediately.
* The real reason to push for adding `Span` is I'm intending to add some new feature PRs that make more sense to use `Span` to pass parameters than `LocalVector` or similar, so wanted to get the ball rolling on this first as a pre-requisite.
* I've left the `#pragma once` from the 4.x PR rather than header guards. I think it passes CI as a few have sneaked through already - long term I'm aiming to convert the 3.x header guards to `#pragma once` as in 4.x, as these are a lot easier to use, provided everyone else is okay with this.
* I've not done the `Span` conversion for `PoolVector` here but will leave for a follow up as it deserves discussion in its own right.
* There are a few cases from portal system where I was using `LocalVector` with signed count, which were not directly convertible to span so I added explicit constructors. I might see if these can be converted later to regular `LocalVector` to make things neater in the calling code.
